operations.description: Deletes an application that is specified either by its application ID, name, or ARN. All associated attribute groups and resources must be disassociated from it before deleting an application.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete application [PATH] applications [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] application delete exception found not resource response summary

operations.description: Disassociates an attribute group from an application to remove the extra attributes contained in the attribute group from the application's metadata. This operation reverts AssociateAttributeGroup.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] disassociate attribute group [PATH] applications attribute groups [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application attribute content credential date group headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] application arn attribute disassociate exception found group not resource response

operations.description: Disassociates a resource from application. Both the resource and the application can be specified either by ID or name.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] disassociate resource [PATH] applications resources [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers resource security sha signature signed token type x [SCHEMA] application arn disassociate exception found not resource response throttling

operations.description: Deletes an attribute group, specified either by its attribute group ID, name, or ARN.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete attribute group [PATH] attribute groups [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz attribute content credential date group headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] attribute delete exception found group not resource response summary

operations.description:
Removes tags from a resource.

This operation returns an empty response if the call was successful.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] untag resource [PATH] tags resource arn tag keys [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz arn content credential date headers keys resource security sha signature signed tag token x [SCHEMA] exception found not resource response untag

operations.description: Retrieves a list of all of your applications. Results are paginated.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list applications [PATH] applications [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] application applications list next response summaries summary token

operations.description: Retrieves metadata information about one of your applications. The application can be specified by its ARN, ID, or name (which is unique within one account in one region at a given point in time). Specify by ARN or ID in automated workflows if you want to make sure that the exact same application is returned or a ResourceNotFoundException is thrown, avoiding the ABA addressing problem.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] application [PATH] applications [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] application arn association conflict count description exception found id integrations name not resource response tag tags timestamp value

operations.description: Lists the details of all attribute groups associated with a specific application. The results display in pages.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list attribute groups for application [PATH] applications attribute group details [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] application attribute details exception for found group groups list next not resource response token

operations.description: Lists all attribute groups that are associated with specified application. Results are paginated.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list associated attribute groups [PATH] applications attribute groups [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] associated attribute exception found group groups id ids list next not resource response token

operations.description:
Lists all of the resources that are associated with the specified application. Results are paginated.

If you share an application, and a consumer account associates a tag query to the application, all of the users who can access the application can also view the tag values in all accounts that are associated with it using this API.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list associated resources [PATH] applications resources [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] associated exception found info list next not resource resources response token

operations.description: Gets the resource associated with the application.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] associated resource [PATH] applications resources [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers resource security sha signature signed token type x [SCHEMA] associated exception found not resource response

operations.description: Lists all attribute groups which you have access to. Results are paginated.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list attribute groups [PATH] attribute groups [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] attribute group groups list next response summaries summary token

operations.description: Retrieves an attribute group by its ARN, ID, or name. The attribute group can be specified by its ARN, ID, or name.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] attribute group [PATH] attribute groups [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz attribute content credential date group headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] arn attribute attributes by conflict created description exception found group id name not resource response tag tags timestamp value

operations.description: Retrieves a TagKey configuration from an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] configuration [PATH] configuration [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] app configuration registry response

operations.description: Lists all of the tags on the resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list tags for resource [PATH] tags [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz arn content credential date headers resource security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] exception for found list not resource response tag tags value

operations.description: Updates an existing application with new attributes.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] update application [PATH] applications [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] application conflict exception found not resource response throttling update

operations.description: Updates an existing attribute group with new details.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] update attribute group [PATH] attribute groups [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz attribute content credential date group headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] attribute conflict exception found group not resource response update

operations.description: Creates a new application that is the top-level node in a hierarchy of related cloud resource abstractions.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create application [PATH] applications [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] application conflict create exceeded exception quota response service tag throttling value

operations.description: Creates a new attribute group as a container for user-defined attributes. This feature enables users to have full control over their cloud application's metadata in a rich machine-readable format to facilitate integration with automated workflows and third-party tools.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create attribute group [PATH] attribute groups [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] attribute conflict create exceeded exception group quota response service tag value

operations.description:
Syncs the resource with current AppRegistry records.

Specifically, the resource’s AppRegistry system tags sync with its associated application. We remove the resource's AppRegistry system tags if it does not associate with the application. The caller must have permissions to read and update the resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] sync resource [PATH] sync [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers resource security sha signature signed token type x [SCHEMA] action application arn conflict exception found not resource response sync throttling

operations.description:
Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified resource.

Each tag consists of a key and an optional value. If a tag with the same key is already associated with the resource, this action updates its value.

This operation returns an empty response if the call was successful.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] tag resource [PATH] tags [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz arn content credential date headers resource security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] exception found not resource response tag value

operations.description: Associates an attribute group with an application to augment the application's metadata with the group's attributes. This feature enables applications to be described with user-defined details that are machine-readable, such as third-party integrations.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] associate attribute group [PATH] applications attribute groups [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application attribute content credential date group headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] application arn associate attribute conflict exceeded exception found group not quota resource response service

operations.description: Associates a resource with an application. The resource can be specified by its ARN or name. The application can be specified by ARN, ID, or name.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] associate resource [PATH] applications resources [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz application content credential date headers resource security sha signature signed token type x [SCHEMA] application arn associate conflict exceeded exception found not quota resource response service throttling

operations.description: Associates a TagKey configuration to an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] put configuration [PATH] configuration [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] configuration conflict exception query tag
